discription: A simple FM synth with a sine wave carrier and modulator, featuring a fast decay envelope for plucked sounds.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, carRatio=1, modRatio=1, modIndex=1, attack=0.005, decay=0.2; var car, mod, sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.perc(attack, decay, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); mod = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio); mod = mod * (modIndex * freq * env); car = SinOsc.ar(freq * carRatio + mod); sig = car * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
